title: Integer-Input RS Encoder HDL Optimized
source_docs: Communications Toolbox HDL Support/Error Detection and Correction/Block/Integer_Input_RS_Encoder_HDL_Optimized.md
text: Encode data using a Reed-Solomon (RS) encoder, 4 inputs, 4 outputs; {Codeword length} sets the length of codeword, {Message length} sets the length of message, {Source of primitive polynomial} sets the primitive polynomial source, {Primitive polynomial}, {Source of puncture pattern} sets the puncture pattern source, {Puncture pattern vector} sets the puncture vector, {Source of B, the starting power for roots of the primitive polynomial} sets the starting power for roots of primitive and {B value} sets the starting exponent of roots. Values come from the instance.
